translation:
S-summer is the best season for manju, isn't
it?

…I think they're delicious whatever the
season, but why say that all of a sudden?

If I had to pick a season, I feel like they're
best in the winter.

Why are we talking about manju all of a
sudden?

Umm, when we went to question the computer
society, we were offered them with tea.

Ehhh? Who knew those guys were capable of
such hospitality.

But instead of eating it, Nagato took it as
some kind of souvenir…

A souvenir? A souvenir… I don't really get
what you mean by that…

Instead of eating it, she handed it to Kyon,
calling it a souvenir.

I don't really understand but, is this about
how Yuki is a strange girl?
Eh? I didn't really mean it like that—

So what you're saying is… Kyon still has the
bun even now?

Little sister—swipe it from Kyon and we'll split
it between the two of us.
